snapshot.scope_boundary: Only the twelve named release/tooling unit files. This does not complete the rest of Layer 4 or qualify hosted, provider, or release services.

review_method.enumeration: Exact loaded family IDs and file SHA-256 values come from the frozen deterministic inventory.
review_method.substance: Ripwire bodies/callees and focused source reads established the implementation, parser, mock, filesystem, subprocess, or declaration boundary before disposition.
review_method.claim_rule: Each exact method symbol states its narrow requirement inside the referenced evidence profile; passing alone was not used as disposition evidence.

provider-admission-negative.requirement: Provider lookup must never fall through from controlled fixtures to installed real tools.
provider-admission-negative.failure: An uncontrolled provider executable is launched.
provider-admission-negative.boundary: Mocks executable discovery and launch while exercising the real admission wrapper.
provider-admission-negative.evidence: Asserts unowned paths raise and subprocess launch remains absent; also verifies the child PATH is cleared.

provider-fixture-posix.requirement: Tracked Claude/Codex provider stubs must be executable immutable fixture inputs.
provider-fixture-posix.failure: A generated or mutable test-local provider supplies evidence.
provider-fixture-posix.boundary: POSIX symlink/executable semantics; skipped on Windows by design.
provider-fixture-posix.evidence: Checks both clients in success and failure modes resolve to tracked fixture bytes outside the temporary directory.

refresh-cli-stubbed.requirement: Local refresh CLI option, dry-run, validation, install/remove, scope, marketplace, and failure behavior must remain stable.
refresh-cli-stubbed.failure: The helper invokes unsafe/unexpected clients, ignores failures, or emits wrong refresh commands.
refresh-cli-stubbed.boundary: Executes the real CLI with tracked provider stubs; dry-run output is not proof that installed clients changed.
refresh-cli-stubbed.evidence: Twenty-two concrete subtests assert argv, call logs, return codes, opt-outs, validation, identity, and error messages.

artifact-refresh-temp-git.requirement: Artifact refresh check mode must isolate regeneration, compare bytes/modes/symlinks, report drift, and avoid source mutation.
artifact-refresh-temp-git.failure: Check mode mutates source, ignores drift/errors, or snapshots local worktrees.
artifact-refresh-temp-git.boundary: Real temporary filesystem and Git/index operations; no generated repository artifacts are changed.
artifact-refresh-temp-git.evidence: Families exercise clean, dirty, error, ignored-file, mode, symlink, isolated-copy, and default mutating-path branches.

release-audit-injected-io.requirement: Release-note audit must fail closed and emit byte-exact records, digests, summaries, and diagnostics.
release-audit-injected-io.failure: Capture/download/composer/API failures are hidden or success records are malformed.
release-audit-injected-io.boundary: Production audit logic with injected subprocess and URL I/O; no live GitHub API.
release-audit-injected-io.evidence: Covers acquisition, metadata, digest, composer, API, success, and output contracts. The two zero-direct-assert callers delegate to a shared helper containing eight concrete assertions.

release-dispatch-injected-subprocess.requirement: Release PR dispatch must validate metadata, use argv GH calls, and stop/report child failure.
release-dispatch-injected-subprocess.failure: Malformed metadata dispatches or child failure is masked.
release-dispatch-injected-subprocess.boundary: Injected subprocess runner; no live workflow dispatch.
release-dispatch-injected-subprocess.evidence: Exercises valid, malformed/empty/incomplete, and failing child results with exact argv/status assertions.

release-lifecycle-fake-gh.requirement: Release PR lifecycle must hold drafts until artifact sync and mark only synchronized PRs ready.
release-lifecycle-fake-gh.failure: Review readiness advances without metadata/artifact synchronization or repeats destructive actions.
release-lifecycle-fake-gh.boundary: Real lifecycle logic with a fake GH command surface.
release-lifecycle-fake-gh.evidence: Covers existing draft idempotence, synchronized readiness, missing metadata, and workflow hold ordering.

release-reconciliation-injected-runner.requirement: Release PR reconciliation must discover safely, merge before refresh, resolve only generated conflicts, preserve diagnostics, and push in order.
release-reconciliation-injected-runner.failure: Unsafe branches or non-generated conflicts are accepted, ordering changes, or diagnostics disappear.
release-reconciliation-injected-runner.boundary: Production functions with recorded fake command runners; no remote mutation.
release-reconciliation-injected-runner.evidence: Exact call/result assertions cover no-op, discovery, unsafe branch, merge/refresh/push ordering, generated/non-generated conflicts, and path derivation.

runner-request-local-subprocess.requirement: Runner request dispatch must preserve order/bytes/environment and stop or normalize on failures/signals.
runner-request-local-subprocess.failure: Requests reorder, lose bytes, continue after failure, or accept missing input.
runner-request-local-subprocess.boundary: Real local temporary subprocesses; not provider execution.
runner-request-local-subprocess.evidence: Four independent families exercise success ordering, first failure, signal status, and absent requests.

windows-preflight-emulated-runner.requirement: Hosted Windows preflight validation must enforce platform/architecture/version/ref/envelope/metadata/timeout contracts.
windows-preflight-emulated-runner.failure: Mismatched or unverified Windows evidence is accepted.
windows-preflight-emulated-runner.boundary: Windows facts and subprocess outcomes are injected on the current host; this is not a hosted Windows run.
windows-preflight-emulated-runner.evidence: Sixteen families cover success plus architecture, platform, version, mutable ref, process, timeout, JSON, envelope, and metadata failures.

container-dispatch-injected-runner.requirement: Container/Windows dispatch must classify changes, honor draft/availability rules, select exact interpreters, and scope child requests safely.
container-dispatch-injected-runner.failure: Heavy checks are wrongly skipped/run, architecture or interpreter identity drifts, or unsafe directories reach children.
container-dispatch-injected-runner.boundary: Production dispatch helpers with injected GitHub metadata, runners, and interpreters; not hosted execution.
container-dispatch-injected-runner.evidence: Eighteen families assert change detection, sentinel truth table, stable verdicts, Linux/Windows selection, argv, pins, and identity failures.

actionlint-temp-archive.requirement: Actionlint installation/execution must verify checksum/member/path/mode and deterministic workflow argv.
actionlint-temp-archive.failure: Unsafe archives, checksum drift, nonexecutables, nondeterministic argv, or subprocess failure are accepted.
actionlint-temp-archive.boundary: Temporary archives and injected download/process surfaces; no network download.
actionlint-temp-archive.evidence: Seven positive/negative families cover exact archive member, traversal, digest, executable mode, ordering, and failures.

docs-classifier-pure.requirement: Docs change classification must preserve exact path boundaries and validation/reference modes.
docs-classifier-pure.failure: Prefix lookalikes or wrong source categories select an incorrect CI mode.
docs-classifier-pure.boundary: Direct production classifier calls plus captured argv/output.
docs-classifier-pure.evidence: Ten families use fixed nonempty path matrices and assert all classification flags and output ordering.

workflow-results-pure.requirement: Workflow result aggregation must preserve the success/skipped/failure/cancelled truth table and annotation.
workflow-results-pure.failure: Failure/cancellation passes or error output drifts.
workflow-results-pure.boundary: Direct helper calls; no hosted workflow.
workflow-results-pure.evidence: Six families cover test/artifact status precedence, skipped behavior, and exact GitHub error text.

plugin-matrix-injected-io.requirement: Static plugin matrix output must append exact compact JSON.
plugin-matrix-injected-io.failure: Matrix bytes or GitHub output behavior drift.
plugin-matrix-injected-io.boundary: Direct helper with temporary output file.
plugin-matrix-injected-io.evidence: Asserts exact compact payload and append behavior.

docs-artifact-temp-filesystem.requirement: Docs artifact prepare/verify must confine deletion and reject missing, empty, outside, link, file, and special-file targets.
docs-artifact-temp-filesystem.failure: Validation deletes adjacent/outside paths or accepts unsafe/empty artifacts.
docs-artifact-temp-filesystem.boundary: Real temporary filesystem; no docs build or upload.
docs-artifact-temp-filesystem.evidence: Seventeen focused families exercise each path and object-type boundary plus CLI annotation.

marketplace-sync-local-cli.requirement: Marketplace version sync must update exact local entries and fail clearly for malformed/missing/unsafe version sources.
marketplace-sync-local-cli.failure: Versions drift silently, invalid JSON/semver passes, or external sources are mutated.
marketplace-sync-local-cli.boundary: Real CLI against temporary marketplaces; no published marketplace.
marketplace-sync-local-cli.evidence: Forty-six explicit subtests cover match/mismatch, multi-plugin, missing/malformed fields, semver, external sources, formatting, and no-jq operation.

hook-port-local-subprocess.requirement: Claude hook ports must parse payloads, enforce guard/structural triggers, propagate failures, and avoid shell/jq execution.
hook-port-local-subprocess.failure: Hooks accept malformed/unsafe operations, miss trigger paths, or invoke shell facilities.
hook-port-local-subprocess.boundary: Real hook modules/local subprocesses with temporary fake repository runners; not a Claude session.
hook-port-local-subprocess.evidence: Nineteen source and behavior subtests run a fixed two-hook tuple and inspect AST/source restrictions.

bash-guard-temp-git-parser.requirement: Repository Bash confinement must classify tracked Python/workflow/JSON/instruction inputs and fail closed at path, binding, provenance, and dynamic-template boundaries.
bash-guard-temp-git-parser.failure: Forbidden shell reaches active paths, safe direct dispatch is blocked, or error envelopes claim successful inspection.
bash-guard-temp-git-parser.boundary: Production scanner over temporary Git repositories and synthetic files; not proof against every shell grammar.
bash-guard-temp-git-parser.evidence: Families target distinct allowlist, argv, binding, workflow, symlink, diagnostic, provenance, and instruction-history failure modes.

bash-fixture-matrix-vacuous.requirement: Every canonical Bash-confinement fixture case must run and satisfy the result schema/status/category contract.
bash-fixture-matrix-vacuous.failure: The fixture roster becomes empty and the named matrix passes without a case.
bash-fixture-matrix-vacuous.boundary: Production guard over temporary Git repos, but roster ownership is missing.
bash-fixture-matrix-vacuous.evidence: Bounded control patched CASES=[] for this family only; it ran one unittest and passed with zero iterations.
bash-fixture-matrix-vacuous.replacement: Assert an exact nonempty canonical case-ID roster before the loop, then retain every current result-contract/status/category assertion.

bash-guard-composition-declaration.requirement: Registry, release, and default suite composition must retain the Bash-confinement operation.
bash-guard-composition-declaration.failure: The operation drops from one dispatch surface.
bash-guard-composition-declaration.boundary: Static registry/suite composition; not scanner execution.
bash-guard-composition-declaration.evidence: Directly asserts the operation in all named composition surfaces.

semantic-dispatch-registry.requirement: Release dispatch must resolve semantic operations and reject unknown input rather than ordinal aliases.
semantic-dispatch-registry.failure: Unknown or duplicated ordinal inputs dispatch.
semantic-dispatch-registry.boundary: Direct registry/dispatch resolution; no release action.
semantic-dispatch-registry.evidence: Asserts both known semantic operations and unknown-value rejection.

whole-tree-privacy-scan.requirement: The tracked current tree must exclude private emails, local paths, transcript paths, identifiers, dynamic local terms, tooling leaks, and committed transcripts.
whole-tree-privacy-scan.failure: Sensitive material enters a scanned tracked surface.
whole-tree-privacy-scan.boundary: Real current-tree scan; findings may originate in concurrent files outside this audit's write ownership.
whole-tree-privacy-scan.evidence: A fixed literal ten-check roster includes positive detector controls. The focused run failed three categories on concurrent files, demonstrating the guard is neither mocked nor tautological.

release-note-policy-pure.requirement: Release-note extraction, sanitization, link/image/HTML handling, length caps, empty validation, and title normalization must fail safely.
release-note-policy-pure.failure: Nested fences, unsafe markup/links/images, oversized or empty notes, or marker-only titles pass.
release-note-policy-pure.boundary: Direct production policy calls with fixed nonempty adversarial strings.
release-note-policy-pure.evidence: Thirteen families isolate syntax and transform-order boundaries with positive and negative assertions.

release-policy-dependency-declaration.requirement: The release-note policy and its test dependency boundary must remain production-only and standard-library-only.
release-policy-dependency-declaration.failure: The policy imports non-stdlib/runtime-unapproved dependencies or the suite tests a shadow implementation.
release-policy-dependency-declaration.boundary: AST/import declaration checks, not sanitizer behavior.
release-policy-dependency-declaration.evidence: Two families inspect imports and suite production-module binding.

compose-release-notes-injected-io.requirement: Release-note composition must discover commits/PRs, sanitize/fallback, enforce required checks, bind snapshots, and remain deterministic/idempotent.
compose-release-notes-injected-io.failure: Commits/PRs are omitted, unsafe content survives, malformed input passes, or reruns drift.
compose-release-notes-injected-io.boundary: Production composition with temporary snapshots and injected HTTP/GH/process responses; dry-run is not a live release.
compose-release-notes-injected-io.evidence: Twenty-two distinct families cover discovery, limits, deduplication, fallbacks, required checks, capture/load, transport failure, and byte-identical reruns.

compose-live-path-injected-io.requirement: The live-path orchestration must resolve by tag, patch audited raw body, reuse immutable snapshots, and reject tampering.
compose-live-path-injected-io.failure: Mutable metadata changes a rerun or tampered payload is reused.
compose-live-path-injected-io.boundary: The method name says live, but network/GitHub are injected; no live release mutation occurs.
compose-live-path-injected-io.evidence: Three families assert exact orchestration, persisted snapshot reuse, and tamper rejection with recorded calls/bytes.

compose-dependency-declaration.requirement: Release composition networking and dependencies must remain standard-library-only.
compose-dependency-declaration.failure: An external runtime dependency or disallowed networking layer enters the script.
compose-dependency-declaration.evidence: Direct assertions inspect the production module dependency/networking surface.

negative_controls.mutation: Patched imported CASES to an empty list in memory for this one unittest.
No mutation; ran against the concurrent tracked tree.
negative_controls.result: Seven of ten checks passed and three correctly failed on newly present private/local identifier material outside this audit's files.
negative_controls.disposition_effect: keep; real repository guard, current tree not clean

implemented_replacements.behavior: The family now asserts the exact ordered 36-case canonical roster before executing every existing result-contract/status/category assertion.
implemented_replacements.red: The pre-repair family passed one unittest with CASES=[] and zero loop iterations.

current_record.body_hash_contract: ast.get_source_segment UTF-8 bytes: no class indentation on the def line and no terminal newline

post_audit_family_refreshes.change_reason: A controller-owned, no-network native-eval Git fixture now uses one fixed synthetic identity. The privacy gate permits that exact identity while retaining every unrelated email protection.
post_audit_family_refreshes.allowlist_scope: One exact address only; no example.invalid domain or pattern allowlist.
post_audit_family_refreshes.targeted_control: The scanner accepts the one exact synthetic fixture identity and still reports one unrelated synthetic .invalid address.
post_audit_family_refreshes.synthetic_fault_input_construction: The unrelated .invalid address is assembled from fixed source fragments solely so the privacy scanner can exercise its negative path without flagging its own test fixture. It is not derived from, or intended to conceal, an actual address.
red: Before the correction, the full privacy gate reported 9/10 and identified the two controller-owned fixture identity lines.
After adding the targeted control but before adding the exact allowlist entry, the exact synthetic fixture identity was reported and the gate remained 9/10.
green: git diff --check passed for the test file
post_audit_family_refreshes.qualification_boundary: No provider, network, generator, broad suite, or host-configuration action was performed.

tests/speckit-pro/unit/test-repo-bash-co: nonempty blocked targets and fixed syntax tuple
tests/speckit-pro/unit/test-release-note: nonempty unsafe destinations and fixed safe URL tuple

application_constraints: Do not remove a family marked replace until its non-vacuous executable replacement is present.
Hosted Windows, fake GH, injected network, dry-run, and provider-stub families retain only their stated implementation boundary.
Three skip-decorated families are deliberate POSIX file-mode/symlink checks, not evidence on Windows.
